description: 2 tactical challenges for Black in the Mortimer Trap. Play 4...Ne7!? and punish White's greed.

drills.briefExplanation: 4...Ne7! 5.Nxe5? c6! 6.Nc4 d6 — the bishop is embarrassed and Black regains the pawn with interest.
drills.description: Black to play. White plays the quiet 4.d3 — answer with the Mortimer 4...Ne7!.
drills.explanation: The Mortimer Variation: 4...Ne7 looks passive but hides teeth. If White grabs with 5.Nxe5?, Black plays 5...c6! — attacking the bishop and preparing ...Ng6 winning the e-pawn back with tempo. After 6.Nc4 d6 Black's center is solid, the bishop on b5 is awkward, and White's 'free' pawn will cost time. Patience, then punishment.
drills.name: The Mortimer Punishment

drills.briefExplanation: 5...Ng6 6.O-O c6 7.Ba4 d6 — reroute, castle, and clamp the bishop with ...c6.
drills.description: Black to play. White develops 5.Nc3 — continue the Mortimer plan.
drills.explanation: Against calm development, the Mortimer unfolds positionally: 5...Ng6 reroutes toward f4 and e5, and after 6.O-O Black plays the key 6...c6! — questioning the b5 bishop at the right moment. 7.Ba4 d6 completes a rock-solid Berlin structure with the two bishops and easy play. The 'trap' here is strategic: White's Spanish bishop achieves nothing.
drills.name: The Slow Squeeze
